text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! You're quite skilled!
As expected of my Trainer!
choice_data_list: I couldn't get that many, though...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about!
Trainer kept their promise fair and square.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Besides, this Paka Petit you won for me will look perfect in my room.
How could I possibly have any complaints!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I'm going straight home
to put this little guy on display!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: On the desk... no, maybe placing it by my pillow would be nice too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer!
See you later!
